units.source_text: “过了一个星期，我又遇到了一次同样的情况。

en.t: About a week later, I found myself in the same situation again.

units.source_text: 当时，小姐一看见我就笑起来。

en.t: At that moment, the young lady burst out laughing as soon as she saw me.

units.source_text: 我马上问她一句笑什么就好了，

en.t: I should simply have asked her at once what she was laughing at,

units.source_text: 可我却默默地进了自己的房间。

en.t: but instead I silently went into my own room.

units.source_text: 因此K也没机会像往常那样说声‘刚回来？’

en.t: So K had no chance to say, as he usually did, 'Just got back?'

units.source_text: 而小姐也立刻拉开隔扇，回客厅去了。

en.t: And the young lady immediately slid open the partition and went back to the sitting room.

units.source_text: 吃晚饭的时候，小姐说我是个怪人。

en.t: At dinner, the young lady said I was a strange person.

units.source_text: 当时我也没有问小姐怪在哪里，

en.t: Even then, I did not ask her what was strange about me,

units.source_text: 只注意到夫人瞪了小姐一眼。

en.t: and only noticed the lady of the house glare at the young lady.

units.source_text: 饭后，我叫K一起出去散步。

en.t: After dinner, I asked K to go out for a walk with me.

units.source_text: 我们两人从传通院后门去了植物园那条街，绕了一圈，又走下了富坂。

en.t: The two of us went from the back gate of Dentsuin to the street by the botanical garden, made a circuit, and then walked down Tomizaka.

units.source_text: 散步的时间可不算短，但其间两个人很少说话。

en.t: It was not a short walk, but during it the two of us said very little.

units.source_text: 从性格来说，K比我更不爱说话，而我也不是个健谈的人。

en.t: By nature, K was even less talkative than I was, and I was not a good talker either.

units.source_text: 但是，一边散步，我一边尽量主动跟他说话。

en.t: Still, as we walked, I tried as much as I could to start conversations with him.

units.source_text: 我说的主要是有关我们寄宿的这户人家。

en.t: What I mainly talked about was the household where we were lodging.

units.source_text: 因为，我很想知道他对夫人和小姐的看法。

en.t: That was because I very much wanted to know what he thought of the lady of the house and the young lady.

units.source_text: 而他的回答总是云里雾里的，

en.t: But his replies were always vague and elusive,

units.source_text: 让人不得要领，而且甚为简单。

en.t: hard to grasp, and extremely brief besides.

units.source_text: 比起这两个女人来，仿佛他更关心的是学业。

en.t: Compared with those two women, he seemed far more concerned with his studies.

units.source_text: 况且面临着第二学年的考试，在一般人看来，他比我更像个学生。

en.t: Moreover, with the second-year examinations approaching, to ordinary eyes he looked more like a student than I did.

units.source_text: 再加上他滔滔不绝地谈论斯威登堡，使不学无术的我惊讶不已。

en.t: On top of that, he spoke at length about Swedenborg, leaving my ignorant self utterly astonished.
